author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices steady beat, high and low, loud and soft, stop and go, and playing together, with an old up-and-down seesaw rhyme.

classes.title: Rock like a seesaw
classes.goal: Feel the steady beat of the song by rocking back and forth together.

mathTarget.parentLine: A movement that comes back again and again, evenly

classes.parentPrompt: Sit facing your child, hold hands and rock forward and back on every beat.
classes.childAction: Rock back and forth with your grown-up, like a seesaw.
classes.bridge: The song rocks like a seesaw: up, down, up, down, never in a hurry.

intro.caption: Let's rock like a seesaw
intro.parentCue: hold hands and rock forward and back

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: feeling the steady beat, together.

classes.title: Tap the seesaw beat
classes.goal: Tap one steady tap on each beat while the grown-up plays the tune.

mathTarget.parentLine: One tap for each beat, no more, no less

classes.parentPrompt: Rest your hand over your child's hand and tap together, then slowly let go.
classes.childAction: Tap any key once on each beat. Any key is right.
classes.bridge: Each beat is one bump of the seesaw; one tap for every bump.

intro.caption: One bump, one tap
intro.parentCue: tap your child's knee on each beat

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: one tap for each beat.

classes.title: Bear low, bird high
classes.goal: Hear low and high sounds and tap the matching side of the piano.

mathTarget.parentLine: Low sounds live on the left, high sounds on the right

classes.parentPrompt: Crouch and growl for the bear; stretch up and flap for the bird.
classes.childAction: Bear sound: tap the left side. Bird sound: tap the right side.
classes.bridge: The seesaw dips low for the bear on the left, lifts high for the bird.

intro.caption: Bear lives low, bird lives high
intro.parentCue: point left for bear, right for bird

games.caption: Up and down, see and saw
games.parentCue: Lift your child's arms up, then down

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing high and low sounds.

classes.title: Big seesaw, little seesaw
classes.goal: Tap the beat with big loud taps, then with tiny soft taps.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same tap, made bigger or smaller

classes.parentPrompt: Make big strong arms for loud taps; whisper and tiptoe your fingers for soft.
classes.childAction: Loud: big strong taps. Soft: tiny whisper taps.
classes.bridge: Loud taps are a big seesaw bump; soft taps are a feather landing.

intro.caption: Big taps, tiny taps
intro.parentCue: loud means strong arms, not banging

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing loud and soft.

classes.title: Turtle and bunny ride
classes.goal: Follow the music as it goes slow like a turtle and fast like a bunny.

mathTarget.parentLine: Same tune, same shape, only the speed changes

classes.parentPrompt: Rock slowly with your child for turtle music, then quickly for bunny music.
classes.childAction: Turtle music: slow taps. Bunny music: quick taps.
classes.bridge: Slow taps are turtle steps; fast taps are bunny hops across the keys.

intro.caption: Turtle slow, bunny fast
intro.parentCue: slow down if the taps get wild

games.caption: Bunny rides the seesaw
games.parentCue: Same song, now quick and light

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: following slow and fast music.

classes.title: Seesaw, freeze!
classes.goal: Tap while the music plays and freeze when it stops.

mathTarget.parentLine: When the sound stops, the hands stop too

classes.parentPrompt: Freeze with a funny face when the music stops; cheer when it starts again.
classes.childAction: Tap while the music plays. Freeze like a statue when it stops.
classes.bridge: Music on, the seesaw rocks; music off, the seesaw holds still.

intro.caption: Tap, tap... freeze!
intro.parentCue: make freezing silly, like a statue

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: listening for stop and go.

classes.title: Tap the seesaw words
classes.goal: Tap one tap for each sung word, saying the words together.

mathTarget.parentLine: Each word we sing gets one tap

classes.parentPrompt: Say the words slowly with your child and tap their hand on every word.
classes.childAction: Say the words and tap one tap for each one.
classes.bridge: Every word is a little hop on the seesaw: See. Saw. Mar-ger-y Daw.

intro.caption: Tap with the words
intro.parentCue: say the words slowly, tap each one

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: one tap for each word.

classes.title: Guess the music game
classes.goal: Listen and switch between games: high and low, loud and soft, fast and slow.

mathTarget.parentLine: Sorting each sound: high or low, loud or soft?

classes.parentPrompt: Pause before each picture and ask: bear or bird? Loud or soft? Then cheer.
classes.childAction: Guess the game, then tap high, low, loud, soft, slow or fast.
classes.bridge: Every sound wears a costume: bear, bird, loud, soft, turtle or bunny.

intro.caption: What game is it?
intro.parentCue: let your child guess first; any guess is fine

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: telling sounds apart and switching games.

classes.title: You and me, seesaw duet
classes.goal: Make the song together: the grown-up plays the tune, the child keeps the beat.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two different jobs fit together to make one song

classes.parentPrompt: Play the tune and watch your child; if they stop, keep playing and smile.
classes.childAction: Tap the beat on any key while your grown-up plays the tune.
classes.bridge: A seesaw needs two friends: one plays the tune, one keeps the beat.

intro.caption: I play, you tap
intro.parentCue: sit side by side at the piano

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing one song together, two jobs.

classes.title: Seesaw concert for teddy
classes.goal: Play the whole song from the first note to the last, then bow together.

mathTarget.parentLine: A song starts, goes on and ends; we finish together

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the audience; play the tune, then clap, cheer and bow together.
classes.childAction: Tap the beat to the very end, then take a big bow.
classes.bridge: The song is one seesaw ride: climb on, rock, rock, then hop off.

intro.caption: Concert time for teddy!
intro.parentCue: put teddy in front as the audience

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song, start to end.
